mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (username, password, email, birth_year, reg_date, updated_date) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{birthYear}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM member ORDER BY no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET username = #{username}, password = #{password}, email = #{email}, birth_year = #{birthYear}, updated_date = NOW() WHERE no = #{no}
